blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The Right to Information (RTI) emerged directly from grassroots movements demanding transparency in public governance.
The movement was significantly inspired by the Mazdoor Kisan Shakti Sangathan (MKSS) initiative in Rajasthan.
The fundamental Right to Know is legally recognized as a component of Article 19(1)(a) (Freedom of Speech and Expression).
